title: Composition of the normalized etale dualizing comparison
statement: Fix the finite coefficient datum [def-pur-conventions], with coefficient ring $\Lambda$. Let $X\xrightarrow{v}Y\xrightarrow{w}Z\xrightarrow{h}B$ be separated finite-type morphisms [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with $v,w$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], $h$ smooth of pure relative dimension $r$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and $B$ finite type over the fixed field. Let $F:X\to Z$ and $b:X\to B$ be separated finite-type maps with $vw=F$ and $Fh=b$; assume $F$ etale and supply compactifications of $h,wh,b$. Write $E$ for the counit-normalized etale comparison [lem-pur-finite-etale-dualizing-normalization], and $\widetilde E(v,h,b)$ for $E(v,h)$ preceded by the exceptional congruence for $b=vh$. Then $\widetilde E(F,h,b)$ equals $\widetilde E(v,wh,b)$ followed by $Lv^*\widetilde E(w,h,wh)$ and inverse canonical pullback composition for $vw=F$ [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. This is an equality of etale-derived arrows. No affine chart, section, diagonal, input equation or orientation is assumed.

proof.text: Eliminate the equalities F=vw and b=hF. Expand the normalized comparison into its exceptional congruence and E. Reflexive congruence is identity because support congruence is identity and conjugacy preserves identity.

Use the CompositeEEquation clause of [lem-pur-etale-cartesian-tower-tensor-comparison], specialized to q=id, q_Q=id, G=J=w, H=v and p=h. Its identity composites have the canonical exceptional congruences, so transport them along id h=h. This is also obtained by expanding E=rho c: associate the exceptional compositors by conjugate compact-support composition, use normalized rho composition, and move the w-exceptional compositor by naturality of rho_v. The result is E_vw,h = E_v,wh followed by v-pullback of E_w,h followed by inverse pullback composition. Restore the eliminated equality names; the inserted congruence is exactly the one displayed.

theorem normalizedE_comp_congr (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Y Z B : Scheme.{u}} (v : X ⟶ Y) (w : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ B)
    (F : X ⟶ Z) (b : X ⟶ B)
    [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [LocallyOfFiniteType v] [QuasiCompact v]
    [Etale w] [IsSeparated w] [LocallyOfFiniteType w] [QuasiCompact w]
    [Etale F] [IsSeparated F] [LocallyOfFiniteType F] [QuasiCompact F]
    [IsSeparated h] [LocallyOfFiniteType h] [QuasiCompact h]
    [IsSeparated b] [LocallyOfFiniteType b] [QuasiCompact b]
    [HasCompactification h] [HasCompactification (w ≫ h)] [HasCompactification b]
    (r : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension r h]
    (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB]
    (hF : v ≫ w = F) (hb : F ≫ h = b) :
    (normalizedE P F h b hb.symm aB).hom =
      (normalizedE P v (w ≫ h) b
        (hb.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ h) hF.symm).trans
          (Category.assoc v w h))) aB).hom ≫
      (pull P v).map (normalizedE P w h (w ≫ h) rfl aB).hom ≫
      (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
        v w F hF.symm).inv.app _
